About WhatSportsOn

WhatSportsOn is a comprehensive live sport TV guide for the your regionand beyond. We track every televised sporting event across free-to-air and subscription channels, so you always know exactly what's on and where to watch it.

Sports We Cover

From the Premier League and Six Nations Rugby to Cricket, Darts, Tennis, Formula 1, Golf, Boxing, NBA, NFL, MLB Baseball, NHL Ice Hockey and MMA — we cover over 30 sports with accurate kick-off times, TV channel listings, and streaming options updated daily.

How It Works

Our listings are updated daily with start times, broadcaster details, and live status for every fixture. Filter by sport, browse by competition or team, or check what's showing on specific TV channels. Switch between days to plan your viewing for the week ahead.
